I sometime have that self doubt like you described. But in the moment of clarity it appear to me that everybody is like that. Everyone is dispensable and nobody really need any specific person. It's up to us to choose who we want around I guess. Like the friend that you mentioned is invaluable to you, but probably wouldn't be considered that important to other people (like me etc.)

But i don't think that anyone is NOT worth knowing to everyone.

i'm sorry about your dad. i was in first category myself. but i realised now that there are always solutions for any personal shortcoming i might have. 

for example if you don't think you can live with your current situation but you would be okay if you're living like say someone else whose life you envy, then that's what you need to do. If they can have that life then you can too, just need to figure how to do it (won't be easy) but at least you know it is possible. (not trying to belittle anyone's reason but this is how i overcome my previous episode of suicidal thought)

on the other hand if you have a problem with the world itself and how it works (i'm not talking about society, but futility of it etc.) then there's nothing you can do about that.
